verdict.rationale: Helicone is an LLM gateway and observability platform. Such a product could plausibly let users connect MCP servers and route their tools, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents connecting to or consuming MCP servers. Tool-schema variables in prompts and the OpenAI-compatible gateway are adjacent features, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
